summary: Azenta, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the closing of the sale of B Medical Systems S.r.l. to Thelema S.r.l., a company majority owned by Luc Provost (VP of Azenta and CEO of B Medical Systems), via a prior Sale and Purchase Agreement. As part of the transaction, Azenta Germany GmbH provided a $35M vendor loan to Thelema, secured by a first-priority pledge on B Medical equity, bearing 6% interest, maturing in three months. The loan includes customary covenants and prepayment provisions; the arrangement was approved by the Audit Committee due to related-party nature. The filing does not disclose the purchase price, implied value, or premium. The board's recommendation is not mentioned, and advisors are unnamed. Structurally, the vendor loan ties completion to financing terms; the three-month maturity and potential subordination of the pledge to third-party acquisition financing present a near-term payoff risk. Watch for repayment or refinancing that could affect Azenta's balance sheet and any ongoing tax or operational transition.
